auth.label: Secret API Key
auth.description: Snipcart secret API key used as the HTTP Basic Auth username. See https://docs.snipcart.com/v3/api-reference/authentication.

actions.name: get_customer
actions.description: Retrieve one Snipcart customer by ID.

inputSchema.description: The identifier for retrieving one Snipcart customer.

customer.description: The complete customer object returned by Snipcart.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Retrieve one Snipcart order by token.

includeTestOrders.description: Whether a Live-mode key should also search for a Test-mode order.

inputSchema.description: The order token and optional environment behavior for retrieving one order.

order.description: The complete order object returned by Snipcart.

actions.name: list_customers
actions.description: List Snipcart customers with pagination and optional filters.

offset.description: The number of matching records to skip before returning results.

limit.description: The maximum number of records Snipcart should return.

status.description: The customer account status to match.

email.description: The customer email address to match.

from.description: An ISO 8601 date and time used to filter records.

to.description: An ISO 8601 date and time used to filter records.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for listing Snipcart customers.

totalItems.description: The total number of matching records.

offset.description: The number of records skipped for this page.

limit.description: The maximum number of records requested for this page.

items.description: A customer object returned by Snipcart.
The records returned for this page.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List completed Snipcart orders with pagination and optional filters.

offset.description: The number of matching records to skip before returning results.

limit.description: The maximum number of records Snipcart should return.

invoiceNumber.description: The exact invoice number to match.

productId.description: The user-defined product identifier to match.

placedBy.description: The purchaser name or email address to match.

from.description: An ISO 8601 date and time used to filter records.

to.description: An ISO 8601 date and time used to filter records.

includeTestOrders.description: Whether a Live-mode key should also return Test-mode orders.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for listing completed Snipcart orders.

totalItems.description: The total number of matching records.

offset.description: The number of records skipped for this page.

limit.description: The maximum number of records requested for this page.
